build_UniT_model: build a UniT multimodal model from config with DETR base and BERT text encoder
forward_UniT: run a forward pass through the UniT model with a sample list for detection or VL tasks
detection_loss_calculation: calculate detection losses including class logits, bounding boxes, and optional attributes
classifier_loss_calculation: calculate classifier losses for VL and GLUE tasks using pooled hidden states
get_optimizer_parameters: get optimizer parameter groups separating backbone and non-backbone parameters with different learning rates
